newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - March 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - March 14.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on March 14. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

President Suharto has said it is against the law to incite people not to vote in the May 29 general elections. He said Indonesians who do not want to participate in the elections should not encourage others to do so.
United States businesspeople have said recent ethnic and religious riots and uncertainty over political succession in Indonesia would not impact their business interests in the country.

The first ASEAN business summit ended on Thursday with Southeast Asian businessmen calling for an easing in government controls in order to ensure greater integration of the private sector in the region.

Three government ministers escaped unhurt when their helicopter made an emergency landing in Banda Aceh in Aceh province on Thursday. The ministers were accompanying President Suharto during a visit to the province.
